recipe.build:
sed -r '/abi \{/,/}/ s/include .*/include \x27armeabi-v7a\x27/' -i app/build.gradle
export RUSTUP_HOME=/rust/rustup CARGO_HOME=/rust/cargo
./scripts/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain 1.80
export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
TOOLCHAIN=$(grep channel domain/libthreema/rust-toolchain.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)
rustup target add --toolchain $TOOLCHAIN armv7-linux-androideabi aarch64-linux-android i686-linux-android x86_64-linux-android
./gradlew clean -PbuildUniversalApk assembleOnpremRelease
mv app/build/outputs/apk/onprem/release/app-onprem-armeabi-v7a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:
sed -r '/abi \{/,/}/ s/include .*/include \x27x86_64\x27/' -i app/build.gradle
export RUSTUP_HOME=/rust/rustup CARGO_HOME=/rust/cargo
./scripts/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain 1.80
export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
TOOLCHAIN=$(grep channel domain/libthreema/rust-toolchain.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)
rustup target add --toolchain $TOOLCHAIN armv7-linux-androideabi aarch64-linux-android i686-linux-android x86_64-linux-android
./gradlew clean -PbuildUniversalApk assembleOnpremRelease
mv app/build/outputs/apk/onprem/release/app-onprem-x86_64-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

recipe.build:

./scripts/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain 1.80

TOOLCHAIN=$(grep channel domain/libthreema/rust-toolchain.toml | cut -d'"' -f2)

./gradlew clean assembleOnpremRelease
